commit_message:
[Merged] Bug 1961424 - Store CachedBAxisMeasurement's key verbatim instead of hashing them. r=emilio

Instead of bit-packing grid area inline size and baseline padding into a hash,
store them as separate fields to avoid key collisions.

I failed to craft a testcase to cover this change alone. However, with the new
behavior introduced in bug 1944423 (with
`layout.css.grid-multi-pass-track-sizing.enabled` enabled), these WPTs will fail
without this patch.

- css/css-grid/layout-algorithm/grid-fit-content-percentage.html
- css/css-grid/layout-algorithm/grid-container-percentage-001.html

Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D246465

fix_commit_message:
Bug 1965081 - Ensure CachedBAxisMeasurement is valid before accessing it. r=dholbert

Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D248534
agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix a3b707e1ce70 on top of intro c4432f819ee4 via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (UseAfterFree): The cachedMeasurement pointer is obtained at line 5671-5672 and stored in a local variable. Later, ReflowChild() is called at line 5685-5686, which may trigger MarkIntrinsicISizesDirty() -> MarkCachedGridMeasurementsDirty() that removes and frees the CachedBAxisMeasurement property from the frame. After ReflowChild() returns, the code at line 5693-5694 checks if cachedMeasurement is non-null and then calls cachedMeasurement->Update(), but the pointer is now dangling because the object it pointed to was freed during the reflow. This results in a heap-use-after-free write. Root cause: The vulnerability was introduced when Bug 1961424 changed CachedBAxisMeasurement from being stored by value (NS_DECLARE_FRAME_PROPERTY_SMALL_VALUE) to being stored by pointer (NS_DECLARE_FRAME_PROPERTY_DELETABLE). The old code stored the cache directly in the frame property by value and called SetProperty() each time to update it. The new code stores a pointer to a heap-allocated object, and the code pattern of caching the pointer in a local variable and using it after potentially-invalidating operations became unsafe because the pointed-to object could be freed during ReflowChild().
